_rule: A4 Decision 5 - CHAPTERS ARE READING PATHS, NOT CATEGORIES. A chapter is a journey ACROSS layers, never a restatement of one. Eleven layers were never going to be eleven chapters. Every chapter below crosses at least two layer roles; the `crosses` field records which, so the rule is checkable rather than asserted.
